name: Guidejar
description: Interactive product demos / how-to guides / internal docs — record a process (Chrome or desktop), edit, AI voiceover/translate, share or embed; help-center hosting. Free up to 5 guides; paid unlimited. India-founded, ~10k users claimed.

mentions.evidence: ~$5.0k MRR, 215 active subscriptions, ~$5.5k L30, ~$145k all-time, ~10,000 users claimed, founded Jul 2023, India. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Capture → shareable guide for one workflow type (onboarding, SOPs, feature tours). Free tier as SEO funnel; seats/workspaces as upgrade.
